replies.author: TheMasterCow
replies.body:
I believe he used it in a terminology to where it wasn't appropriate/needed to be said and the fact that indeed, rape is something that should not be discussed about on Avicus, especially in that tone.

However, it doesn't directly pertain to micropi. I'll ask some other staff for their opinions on whether this warrants a punishment or not.

replies.body: I disagree. I think that jake deserves maybe 1-3 hour tb. Rape is a very offensive and sensitive topic that should definitely not be brought up on Avicus. Also, if you look at the way he was talking prior to the statement about rape, you will see he has a cocky attitude(calling other users "kids", and saying "the lag is kicking my ass"). From this I can infer that this is not an isolated incident. Your call Para.

replies.author: Princezz_Dubstep
replies.body: I believe Jake should be verbal warned not to do this, as it's unacceptable and a very sensitive topic to some users... I believe verbal warning Jake will give him a better understanding that this isn't okay, rather than just punishing him, since he needs to know the difference from a joke to reality. If he persists to continue this matter of "Joking" then we can take action. As of now, he should be warned verbally that these types of jokes aren't tolerated here on Avicus, as some users are sensitive about this... Just my opinion. :)
